concerns.location: plan.md:Construct Validity of Magnetic Moment as Saturation Magnetization Proxy
concerns.text: The plan treats the DFT‑computed per‑atom magnetic moment (`magnetic_moment`) as a direct proxy for experimental saturation magnetization (Mₛ). While literature cites a linear relationship, the plan provides no calibration against experimental measurements nor quantifies the expected systematic bias of DFT values, risking construct‑validity violations.

External validation samples 200 alloys from the same OQMD/Materials Project pool after cleaning. Because the source and underlying DFT methodology are identical to the training data, this does not constitute a truly independent test of generalization; it may over‑estimate performance on real‑world experimental alloys.

The plan does not address potential confounds such as heterogeneous DFT settings (different functionals, pseudopotentials) across the merged datasets, nor does it model systematic errors that could bias the learned relationships.
